༄༅/ /sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ra be/ rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bla ma la btud de/ /phyi nas de bzhin lha rnams la'o/ /gang zhig rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don/ /mdo tsam dam pas bskul phyir bri/ /dus mthar yul gyi mthar skyes shing*/ /blo dman brtson 'grus zhan mod kyi/ /sngar byas dge ba 'dir sad pas/ /zab mo'i don la dad pa thob/ / slob dpon zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /rgyud kun snang byed rgyud 'di thos/ /rkyen dang rang bzhin rdo rje yi/ /bla ma ji bzhin bsten pa'i mthus/ /cung zad blo gros mig thob nas/ /don bsdus brtsom la spro ba skyes/ /'di ni sde snod gang du gtogs/ /rgyud 'di'i mtshan ni ci zhig yin/ /su zhig gis ni 'di spyan drangs/ /'di gsum thog mar bshad par bya/ /dngos ni dgos don bsdus don tshig don gsum/ /'dir ni de yi bsdus pa'i don bshad pa/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyis don dngos rgyas par bshad/ /phyi ma'i rgyud kyis the tshom bcad pa'o/ /dang po la yang dngos dang rgyud <de nas de bzhin > gtad pa dngos la le'u dang po sngags bshad cing*/ /mchog gtsor bsgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis pa dang*/ /gtso bor las tshogs rab 'byams gsum pa'o/ /mdor bstan sgo nas bshad par zhal bzhes dang*/ <de nas dngos grub/> sngags kyi phan yon sngags kyi byung tshul dang <'das pa'i dus/> sngags kyi dgos pa dang ni rig sngags dngos/ /gnyis pa phan yon rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /las kyi dngos grub <bud med > bde chen 'grub pa <mi dang > dang*/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub che thob pa'o/ /bzhi pa sku bzhi'i dbye bas rnam pa bzhi/ <nges par/> lnga pa dkyil 'khor lha dang <de nas > las sngags gnyis/ / <oṃ ku ru/> de la mu gsum dbye ste dang po'o/ /dang po sngags ston gzhan gnyis cho ga 'chad/ <mkha' la 'gro/> /le'u gnyis pa'i bsdus don lngas/

/lam gyi sngon 'gro phur gdab dang*/ /rnal 'byor chen por 'bras bur bcas/ /rjes su rnal 'byor shin tu sbyor/ /rnal 'byor dang po bshad rnams so/ /dang po phur bus gdab pa la/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phur gdab dang*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i/ /dgra la phur bus gdab pa dang <grog mkhar/> /log 'dren gnod byed gzhan la gdab/ <sbrul dang*/> rdor sems phur bus 'debs pa'o/ <ye shes/> /thog mtha' gnyis la drang nges gnyis/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ /de yi 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po bskyed rim rnal 'byor che/ / de la dngos zla ba dang brtul zhugs dang*/ / <yang na/> de yi bsam gtan las tshogs <rang sngags > so/ /rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po la/ gsungs pa dang ni dogs gcod gnyis/ /dang po lus <lte ba'i dbus su > dang ngag dang <rang sngags > ni/ /sems kyi mi shigs rnal 'byor <sa bon > gsum/ /phyi ma la ni zhus dang lan/ / <de nas rdo rje'i snying po/> dogs pa <don la dgos pa ni 'gro ba sogs > gsum dang dogs gcod <pad+ma'i snying po sogs/ hūṃ > gsum/ /dogs gcod gsum <rim pa rlung gis lus ni shes rab rtogs > ka'ang 'phros dang bcas/ /'bras bu sku gsum bshad pa la/ / <de la 'di'i sku gsum/> /nyer len gzhi yi sku gsum dang*/ / <sems med/> /skabs don dngos <rang byung > dang lus dkyil 'khor <rtsa yi/> /rjes su rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ /zhus pa <dri ma dang > zhus len gnyis/ /de la ngo bo <ston cig > dbye ba dang <a zhes bya/> /sgra <rnam shes > don dang ni rnam pa gsum/ / <de phyir > shin tu sbyor la'ang zhu <spre'u > lan gnyis/ / lan la chags chen lam dgos pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan <nyon cig3gt; 'phros dang bcas pa dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor dngos dang ni/ /sngon 'gro <ha ho > dang ni ye shes bshad/ /sgra don sgo ye shes <nas > che ba bstan/ /dngos la gnas dang grogs dang ni/ / <mig bzang*/>

/cho ga <dang por > byed pa'i dbye ba dang*/ / <phyogs dang*/ > yul gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ / <zab cing*/> /ye shes la ni dga' bzhi dang <de las/> /snying stobs brgyad dang <re bas > ye shes lnga/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi dbye ba'o/ / <rdo rje chu skyes/> lnga pa mthar thug <'di'i rdo rje > gnas skabs gnyis/ <dam tshig3gt; rnal 'byor dang po bshad pa la/ <bar do sbyong byed ut+pal rten bskyed dang nam mkha'i/ /gtso bo bskyed zla ba dang 'khor tshogs spro/ /rang rang go cha bgod dang oṃ ye shes bsre ye shes/> /dbang bskur <ba dbang bsam dang sems 'dzin pa'o rang ltar/ /rnal 'byor bzhi po re re la'ang*/ ming dngos de la 'di ni zhes bya ba bzhi po rnams so/ /rgyas bshad gnyis gnyis dbye/ le'u gsum pa bshad pa la dbang bskur de nas sgrol ma dkyil rdo rje'i > dkyil 'khor 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ <yang > 'pho ba spyod <gsungs > pa dam tshig <de la 'di ni > dang*/ /'khrul 'khor la brten las tshogs dang*/ / <de las/> / 'khrul 'khor spangs pa'i las rnams dang*/ /<gzhan yang rtsa ba'i/> dkyil 'khor 'phros dang lha yi 'phros/ /dbang bskur bzhi pa bshad pa dang*/ <'du ba rdo rjer > btsan thabs sbyor dang mngon byang bshad/ / <lha mo'i/> dkyil 'khor 'phros ni rnam gnyis te/ /sku dang <yang gsung > gsung gi <de nas gsung gi3gt; dkyil 'khor ro/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don te dang po'o/ /gnyis pa phyi ma'i rgyud la ni/ /le'u rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rgyas bshad tshul gyis bzhi pa dang*/ /don bsdus tshul gyis lnga pa'o/ /dang po la ni dum bu bzhi/ /rgyud kyi snying po mtshan nges pa/ /thabs gtsor gyur pa'i dum bu dang*/ / shes rab gtso gyur dum bu dang*/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni cho ga'i 'phros/ /dang po sgra ni ji bzhin par/ /'bras bu'i rnam bzhag 'chad pa dang*/ /ji bzhin min smras legs bshad na/

/lam gyi gsang ba ston par byed/ /phyi ma la'ang rnam pa gsum/ /dbang dang bskyed rim rdzogs rim mo/ /'di dag phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang*/ /sbyor ba a ti sha yis bzhed/ /gnyis pa la ni dkyil 'khor dang*/ rgyud kyi sbyor ba bshad pa gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun rdzob don dam ste/ /dang po thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /thabs la dkyil 'khor phan <de la 'dir ni > yon dang*/ /bskyed chog <ba mo > rnam pa'i khyad par <rdo rje zhe sdang > dang*/ /bsnyen pa <oṃ dzo la > dang ni las kyi sngags/ / <oṃ a h+ya ti/> mchod pa'i bya ba <sha chen > rnams kyis ni/ /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bsdus/ /shes rab sku yi dkyil 'khor dang*/ / <yang gsung*/> /phag mo'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor bstan/ / <yang gsung ba'i phyi ma/> /don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ / <de la 'di ni/> / rigs lnga thabs kyi so sor phye/ /ye shes lnga yi <sho lo ka re re > mtshan nyid bstan/ /shes rab gtso mor bsdus te gsung*/ /de la zhus pa <de nas rdo rje > dang ni lan/ /lan la <nyon cig > bstan bshad bsdus gsum <'khor ba > yod/ / rgyas bshad snang ba sems su bstan <thogs med/> bden pa gnyis su bstan pa dang*/ / <srid med/> /spros bral rang bzhin bshad pa dang <dri med/> /log rtog gol sa gcod pa'o/ / <thams cad dngos po/> /gnyis pa rgyud kyi sbyor ba la/ <de na de bzhin/> /sna tshogs las rnams rgyas pa yi/ /sna tshogs nyi shu'i sgrub thabs dang*/ / <oṃ ma ṇi/> /rmug 'dzin he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ /phyag rgya sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor dang <tām̐ yig3gt; /gtor ma'i cho ga <sngags 'dis > bum chog dang*/ <sgrol ma'i/> /bgegs dang chom po bsrung ba dang <thag ku3gt; /phag mo rmi lam zhal blta <phag mo'i > dang*/ /dbang byed sgrol ma <sgrol ma > byams pa dang*/ / <byams pa'i/> /ku ru kul+le'i gnod sbyin mo <ku ru/> ro langs ma yi cho ga gnyis/ <lho/> gdugs dkar can gyi cho ga dang*/

<rang nyid/> / sa 'og dngos grub sgrub pa lag na dang*/ /gshin rje gshed kyi drag shul sgrub/ / <dpa' bo/> /'byung po rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ / <gzhan yang*/> mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugs dbyung dang*/ /'jig pa brgyad skyob sngags dang ni/ /< oṃ tā re/> /las tshogs phra mo sna tshogs dang*/ <'khor lo/> /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor <nam mkha'i > du/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga dang*/ /rdo rje slob dpon las dang ni <sa chog3gt; / rgyud chen gzhan la kha 'phang dang <kha sbyor > bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ni sngags <oṃ ma ṇi > dang lha'i <nyi ma'i/> /sa bon bstan pa <hriḥ> gsum du dbye/ /mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugs dbyung la/ /sgrub thabs <de nas > sngags dang <oṃ > las tshogs dang*/ / <tshe yig3gt; /sngon byung tshul gyis dkyil 'khor bstan/ / <sngon tshe/> dam tshig bshad <bud med > de rnam pa lnga/ bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad pa la/ /rgyud gzhan du ni sbas pa dang <'on kyang*/ > ngo bo mdo tsam brjod pa dang*/ <mi shes/> /gsum pa bzhi pa'i khyad par dang*/ <skyen las/> / kun rdzob don dam dbye ba dang <las dang*/> bde ba che la 'khrul ba bkag <'jig rten/> don dam dbyings kyi gol sa bcad <lus dang*/> /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin bshad/ / <dngos dang*/> /de nyid dam pa'i bdag tu bstan <kun byed/> /nges don 'gog lam gnyis su dbye/ /rang bzhin kun gzhir <ji ltar > bshad pa dang*/ /yon tan dbyer med bstan pa dang <rdzogs sangs/> /lhun grub rdo rje bzhi rnams so/ /gsum pa shes rab <rdo rje > dum bu la/ /zhus pa dang ni zhus lan gnyis/ /dang po zhu ba po dang ni <de nas/> /zhu ba'i rgyu dang <ye shes su gyur > zhu ba'i yul/ <bcom ldan/> /ji ltar zhus <lus dang > pa'i tshul rnams so/ /de la dri ba bcu gcig go <ji ltar brten zhes sogs/> /gnyis pa lan la bcu gcig ste/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rigs lnga yi/

/dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang <ston cig3gt; /bsdus rgyud gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang <tshe thung*/> / chags chen gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang*/ /bsnyen pa spyi yi dgos pa dang*/ /rlung gi sbyor ba'i rnam bzhag dang*/ /dga' bzhi'i lam gyi rab dbye dang*/ /shes rab ma yi dam tshig dang <dus bzhir/> /dka' ba med pa'i lam bshad dang*/ /rig pa <bskal pa > brtul zhugs spyod tshul dang*/ /btsan thabs sbyor ba'i rab dbye dang*/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid do/ /dang po <sems can kham sogs > gdul bya <drug > zhing <chos 'byung > dang <'das pa'i dus sogs > dus/ dkyil 'khor lam dang <bdag nyid bde ba che sogs drug > dgos pa <bde nas mngon par zhen sogs > yis/ /dbye ba drug po kun la dbye/ /don bsdus dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan <'dir ni/> /bzhi pa la ni bsnyen pa dang*/ /sgrub pa <sbyinasreg > sgrub chen spyod pa'o/ /dang po gang zag <sdig pa > sngon 'gro dang <bgegs 'joms/ yan lag > /grogs dang gnas dang <bram ze > cho ga dang*/ <bris sku/> / phyi nas bsnyen pa chen po'o/ <phyi nas/ /sgrub chen gyi spyod pa > khyad par bdun dang sgrub pa po <dam tshig > nyams med bdun ldan <dam tshig > stobs bzhi tshangs <lha/> /lnga pa rlung sbyor <g.yon pas > rlung mtshan nyid <lte ba/> /rlung gi sgo dang dgos pa <de bzhin > pa'o/ <byed pa'o/> /drug pa gang zag <sgrub pa'i > gnas dang yul/ <lang tsho/> /dga' bzhi skad cig bzhi mtshan nyid/ / <lus ni/> /'ching thabs <mchog tu >thun mong min dgos pa/ / <zhing dang > so so skye dang <chu skyes > 'phags pa yi/ /ra sa ma ṇi'i bde ba dang <rab tu/> /chags chen pa bshad <gzugs mdzes > de sbas dang <phung po/> /nges <dang po > bstan dbang bskur dmigs <nus dra'i > bsal dang*/ /shes rab mchog gi lam bstan <bud med dang*/> /theg pa gzhan gyi dogs gcod do/ / <'du shes/> brgyad pa la ni don dngos dang*/

/ <bskal pa/> /sa kyi phyag rgya'i dgos pa bshad <mer me/> /dgu pa <yang > gsang spyod smyon spyod dang*/ / <gzhan du > kun bzang <rdzu 'phrul > phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ / <de nas/> /tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyod pa'o/ <yang na/> /bcu pa btsan thabs sbyor ba drug <rdo rje'i sogs/> /bcu gcig pa la cho ga dang*/ / <mngon par/> /yul dang <gdol ma > : 'gro （《dzaṃ》bral ） tshul <thig le > 'bras bu dang*/ / <'di las/> /byang chub cho ga gzhan bstan dang <yang na/> kha sbyor yan lag bshad pa'o/ / <sangs rgyas/> /'dir ni dum bu bzhi pa la/ dbang bskur 'phros dang <yang gsung pa/> lha yi 'phros/ /le'u lnga pa bshad pa la/ /gsol btab <de nas > dbang bskur <dpal rdo rje > de nyid bshad/ /de la bdud gzhom sbyor ba dang*/ / <rab tu/> /mngon byang rnam lnga'i dag 'bras dang*/ / <oṃ/> /lam dang lam gyi <dbang po > sa mtshams bshad/ / <mi gsal/> /lta ba'i don bsdu <gzugs med > sgrub pa po'i/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa'i khyad par dang <dmigs dang*/> /las rgya'i gsang ba rim <ji ltar > gnyis kyi/ /gsang ba <rtog pas > sa lam rnam bzhag dang*/ /gang <chom pas > zag bdun bshad <las dang po > rang bzhin bstan/ / <stong pa ma yin > sngags kyi dam tshig spyod pa bshad/ / <rnal 'byor dbang po/> /de ltar le'u kun la yang*/ /dngos dang rang ming brjod pa'o/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me las/ /rgyud phyi ma'i bsdus don ste gnyis pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di bsdu na/ /rgyud gsum du ni rnam bsdus te/ /rgyu rgyud rang bzhin dang ni rgyu/ /rang bzhin bshad pa'i don bcu gcig/snang ba sems su bstan pa dang*/ /chos kun spros pa bral bar bstan/ /'khor ba rang bzhin med sgrub cing*/ /don dam rang bzhin yod par bstan/ /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug dang*/ /de la sku gsum rdo rje bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor yon tan dbyer med bstan/ /de nyid kun gzhir bshad pa dang*/

/gnas skabs rigs kyis dbye ba'o/ /de nyid rgyu ru bstan par bya/ /de la rgyu rgyud ngo bo dang*/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba dngos brtags khyad/ /bco lnga rgyu rgyud mngon rtogs so/ /thabs rgyud mngon rtogs dbang dang lam/ /slob dpon slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ /bsten tshul bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ /sa chog sta gon thig tshon las/ /'bri dang rgyan bkram sgrub pa dang*/ /mchod dang bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug dang dbang bskur dang*/ /nyer bsdu rdul tshon bsdu ba ste/ /bco lnga dbang gi mngon rtogs yin/ /lam la sum cu rtsa drug ste/ /dam tshig bskyed rdzogs lta ba dang*/ /spyod pa lam gyi mngon rtogs yin/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg gtor ma dang*/ /las tshogs rnams ni slob dpon las/ /dam tshig bsrung bya bsgrub bya gnyis/ /sgrub po mtshan nyid gnas dus grogs/ /yo byad sgom pa'i cho ga ste/ /

bdun bdun bsnyen sgrub gnyis la dbye/ /las sbyor sgrub po'i mtshan nyid dang*/ /rdzas sngags bsam gtan lha bskul ba'i/ khyad par lnga dang ldan par bzhed/ /rdzogs rim la ni rnal 'byor gsum/ /lta ba thun mong thun mong min/ / 'khrul ba'i gol sa bcad de gsum/ /spyod pa ngo bo nges tshig dus/ /dbye ba cho ga 'bras bu'o/ /dbye na thun mong brtul zhugs dang*/ /nye rgyu mngon par byang chub gnyis/ /dang po la ni rnam pa lnga/ /las kyi tshogs la las dngos grub/ / las la sangs rgyas lha rnams kyi/ /cho ga dang ni las phal ba/ /phyi ma 'khor lo la bsten dang*/ /ma bsten gnyis su mkhas rnams bzhed/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes dang*/ /'phrin las rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /sku ni gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga zhes bstan/ /'phrin las nges pa dbugs dbyung drug /ma nges rnam pa sna tshogs so/ /de ltar don bsdus bla ma'i gsung*/ /gzhan yang rgyud kyi tshad dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni lha'i sgrub thabs/ /dbang chog dang ni las tshogs dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bsam gtan dang*/ /dngos grub cho ga 'bras bu dang*/ /lam gyi che ba bstan pa dang*/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin bshad pa yis/ /rgyud don thams cad bsdus so zhes/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes gsungs/ /sgom bya shes bya'i rang bzhin dang*/ /sgom po sgrub po'i rab dbye dang*/ /'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ /sgom tshul rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang*/ /rnam pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ /sgrub bya las dang dngos grub dang*/ thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ces/ /don bsdus bya zhes mkhas pa'i mchog /slob dpon mi yi nyi ma gsung*/ /gzhan rnams gang dag sngar bstan zin/ /dkyil 'khor sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ /he ru ka gnyis dbugs dbyung drug /mi g.yo dbugs dbyung phag mo ste/ /dngos su bstan pa bcu gnyis so/ /mchog sgrub rnams kyi don du gsung*/

/byams pa rta mgrin 'jigs pa brgyad/ /skyob byed gnyis dang blo 'phel ba'i/ /sgrol ma dkar mo lha lnga dang*/ / 'od zer can dang dka' zlog dang*/ /sum bha lag na rdo rje sogs/ /las tshogs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dag pa'i slob mas slob dpon la/ /yang yang gsol ba btab gyur na/ /nyin bdun bya'am yang na gzhan/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byin/ /ji srid dbang bzhi ma rdzogs pas/ /de srid rgyud rgyal bshad mi bya/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ /thun re thun rer gtor ma dbul/ /srung 'khor mtshams bcad maṇ+ḍal dang*/ /gsol gsum btab ste nyan bshad bya/ /blo gros chung la mdo tsam dang*/ /blo ldan rnams la rgyas par bshad/ /tshig gi sbyor ba la dga' bas/ /de la gtso bor sgra don dang*/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la/ /man ngag shin tu zhib mor bstan/ /byin rlabs rjes gnang bzlas lung sogs/ /mtha' dag zhal gyi rim pa bstan/ /shin tu rtogs pa rgyu rgyud la/ /slob dpon mgon po a ti sha /rang bzhi med pa'i sems su bzhed/ /mi yi nyi ma gzhi dus kyi/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyud du 'dod/ /grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas/ /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug gsungs/ /de yang bden pa'i mtha' bral bzhed/ /phal pa'i dbang du chos kun yang*/ /rgyu rgyud tsam por 'jog go gsung*/ /ngo bo nam yang 'gyur ba med/ /gnas skabs lam du zhugs na 'gyur/ /thabs kyi rgyud ni lam kho nar/ /rā ti gup+ta la sogs gsungs/ /lam zhugs sems su bla ma bzhed/ /gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang*/ /'ga' zhig dam tshig rtsa bar 'dod/ /bla ma'i zhal snga srog yin gsung*/ /spyod pa bskyed rdzogs so so ru/ /sdud pa 'di nyid legs par gsung*/ /rnal 'byor dang po bskyed rim ste/ /lta ba rjes su rnal 'byor yin/ / pho nya'i lam ni shin tu 'dod/ /rang lus rdzogs rim rdzogs rim gyi/ /'bras bur bcas pa rnal 'byor che/

/rnal 'byor la yang rnal 'byor bzhi/ /las rgya don dam ma yin dang*/ /zab lam nges par dgos par bzhed/ /'bras bu kha sbyor nges don te/ /sku la rang snang gzhan snang gnyis/ /rang snang gis bsdus sku bzhi po/ /ldog cha tha dad ngo bo gcig /snang ba sems kyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /gzhan snang gdul bya'i sems kyis bsdus/ /rang snang gis bsdus zhing la sogs/ / thams cad ngo bo gcig ye shes/ kha cig gnyis snang yod par 'dod/ /gzhan dag snang ba med par 'dod/ /de na rgyal ba 'khrul bcas 'gyur/ /kun rdzob mi snang ye shes snang*/ /mngon shes ldan pas gzhan dag gi /rmi lam bzhin tu kun rdzob ni/ /bdag nyid la ni mi snang yang*/ /gzhan la 'khrul ba snang ba mkhyen/ / stong nyid bem por smra rnams kyis/ /rgyud 'di bshad par mi nus pas/ /ye shes dam pa'i don can du/ /'jog pa rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gzigs yul dang*/ /so so skye bo'i blo ngo gnyis/ /mtshungs 'dod de dag sangs rgyas la/ /shin tu bskur 'debs ma yin nam/ /de phyir chos nyid rang rig pa/ /bde chen rgyal ba'i ye shes dang*/ /rnam dbyer med don nges pa dang*/ / kun rdzob med dang don dam pa/ /yod cing rig par 'jog pa ni/ /rgyud 'di'i chos skad rtsa ba yin/ /'khor ba gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ /sbyangs pas dag par 'gyur gsung ba/ /bden med tsam la dgongs zhe na/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes kyang de ltar/ /sbyangs pas dag par 'gyur ro zhes/ khyed cag lugs la thal min nam/ /des na rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di/ /rang blo'i lam du mi 'dren cing*/ / gzhung gi dngos su ches gsal ba/ /bshad pa de de bskyang bar byos/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me las brjod bya don gyi bsdus don ste gsum pa'o/ /gang zhig nges pa'i mtshan ma las/ /rnam par rnyed pa'i spyi btol gyis/ / rgyud don rgya mtshor zhugs pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi bzod par mdzod/

/slob dpon gnas brten mar me mdzad dpal dang/ /mkhas pa nyi mas rnam phye'i legs bshad dang*/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung*/ /ji bzhin rnyed pa zhi ba'i man ngag rnams/ /legs par rdo rje slob dpon zhal snga nas/ /blo ldan dam pa 'ga' las lan gsum thos/ /rgyud rgyal kun gyi nges gsang mthong ba na/ / don bsdus tshigs bcad mar me lta bu brtsams/ /dge 'di'i blo ldan rnams kyi rgyud kyi don/ /ji bzhin rab rtogs rdo rje theg 'di yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la byang chub mchog gzhol ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'grub gyur cig/ces pa 'di ni 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bsdus don ste rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par sbyar ba'o// // sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 284 -- PAGE 273 -- PAGE 272 -
